g.text: Last tokens = those after the question: % right when they see only the name, or the digit

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: How to read: dot = name only, diamond = digit only, tick = another sentence. 3 per row = 3 sets.

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: Labelled = holds but stays above chance. Also fails the rule at ≈ chance: Muse (prose). Pale = control failed.

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: Rule: dot ≤ 35%, diamond ≥ 70%, tick ≥ 90%. n = 5-300. Filled = hybrid, hollow = attention-only.
